scenes.text: Did you know there’s a fifty-mile strip of land in the United States where you could theoretically commit a major crime and walk away completely free?
Welcome to the Yellowstone Zone of Death, a real constitutional loophole created by overlapping court districts.
Because nobody lives in this specific intersection of Idaho and Wyoming, a legal jury cannot be formed to hold a trial.
No jury means no conviction, and though Congress knows about this loophole, it remains unfixed, so would you ever dare to camp here?
